non_claims: This audit checks repository addresses and literal static/runtime references; it does not simulate every browser interaction.
Dynamic links generated from recovered data are governed by their owning ledgers/manifests and are not exhaustively enumerated here.
Frozen historical fossils are not modernized merely to satisfy current runtime conventions.
next: Prefer normal use and specific breakage reports over another broad redesign. If a route fails in-browser, capture exact route + action + visible error and repair that boundary.
audit_corrections: Initial scan falsely flagged a valid directory target because the checker mishandled trailing slashes; directory routes were re-resolved against tree nodes/index.html.
Second scan treated site root '/' as a filesystem target; root correctly resolves to /index.html. No application link repair was required for these audit-only false positives.
